description:
As one of the leading software development companies for the public government sector, we have been leveraging our expertise for over one decade to support public administrations and institutions in their transition towards becoming modern, service-oriented organizations.

We are currently looking for a Financial Controller to join our team and support the company’s financial operations.

Job Responsibilities

  • Monitor budget performance against actual results
  • Analyze financial variances and key performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Support forecasting and financial planning processes
  • Coordinate the recording, review, and reconciliation of financial transactions across primary, financial, and management accounting, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and audit requirements
  • Ensure timely completion of all tax, financial, and operational reporting obligations
  • Oversee the preparation, review, and reporting of all accounting operations
  • Provide financial data and insights to support both operational and strategic decision-making
  • Prepare monthly and annual financial reports in accordance with legal requirements and management needs
  • Ensure timely completion of monthly billing cycles and quarterly financial closures
  • Contribute to internal and cross-departmental projects, as requested by management
  • Prepares data for statistical reports and completes the required forms for relevant reporting periods 
  • Acts proactively to minimize financial and compliance risks, protecting the company from potential penalties 
  • Stays up to date with the latest accounting legislation and best practices 
  • Ensures the implementation of all duties defined by applicable accounting regulations, related methodological norms, and other relevant financial and legal provisions
  • Prepare and provide financial documentation requested by employees
  • Enhance controlling processes and drive reporting automation initiatives
  • Collaborate closely with department managers

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in accounting, controlling, or financial analysis
  • Knowledge of accounting legislation
  • Solid understanding of financial controlling principles, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, cost control, and reporting
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Flexible, independent, and team-oriented mindset
  • Good knowledge of English (written and spoken)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g. SAP, Business Central)
  • Project management experience
  • Good command of German (written and spoken)
